hero.sub: The hail has passed and now you have a roof to deal with, and probably more than the roof. We replace roofs, repair the rest of the storm damage and work with your insurance adjuster through the whole claim. Call for a free estimate.

sections.heading: Hail Doesn't Stop at the Roof
body: After a storm, the roofer looks at the roof, the siding company looks at the siding, and nobody looks at the whole house. Then the claim gets filed for one thing and you find the rest later.

Hail hits everything that faces the storm: shingles, siding, window seals, doors, awnings, gutters. We look at all of it before we talk about a price, so the claim and the repair cover what actually happened.
We're a general contractor, so the same company does the roof, the siding, the windows and the paint. You make one call, not four.

sections.heading: Roof Replacement
body: Hail can ruin a roof you can't see from the driveway. It bruises the shingle and knocks the protective granules loose, and the leaks show up months later.

Other signs are shingles that curl or crack, tabs the wind keeps lifting, and gutters full of grit from the shingles. If your adjuster's report says replace, or you can see daylight in the attic, it's time.
We tear off the old roof, put on the new one and leave the yard clean. We've replaced metal roofs as well as shingle.

sections.quote: We used TWG for a new roof and to repaint our house after the hail storms and could not be happier with the results. They were out quickly and did the work in a professional, efficient manner. … There were many roofing companies working in our area and I can say without hesitation that I think TWG was the best.
sections.name: Andy B.

sections.heading: Your Insurance Claim, Step by Step
body: A claim letter is hard to read when you're also looking at a damaged house. You shouldn't have to learn the process on your own roof.
We work directly with your adjuster to maximize your coverage. You hear from us at each step, and we explain what the claim means for your repair.
That matters most when the first estimate seems low. You have someone who has looked at your roof talking to the adjuster for you.

sections.quote: He was on the phone with me for every step of the process, including working with my insurance, and he made sure I understood everything that was going on.

sections.heading: Siding, Windows and Doors
body: Siding takes the same hail the roof does, and it dents, cracks and splits. Old siding that was never storm damaged still wears out, and we'll tell you which one you have.
When we install new siding, many of the options carry lifetime manufacturer warranties.
Windows are the other place hail does damage you don't see.
Cracked glass is obvious. A failed seal, with fog between the panes, is easier to miss. We replace windows with rotted frames, failed seals or storm damage, and the window page has the details.
We also install entry and security doors in vinyl, wood and fiberglass.

sections.heading: Choosing Who Fixes Your Roof
body: After a big storm, a lot of roofing companies show up on the same streets. Some are here for the season and gone before the first leak.
We're a Wichita company with an office you can drive to. Ask any contractor for their license and proof of insurance. Ours are in order.
Then read our Google reviews. The same few things come up again and again: a quick crew, a clean yard and someone who explained the insurance.

One crew that already knows your house is easier than finding a painter after the roof is done.

sections.quote: We recently had our exterior, and garage reworked by TWG. The workmanship is excellent. Everyone that came to our house was kind, communicative and tidy. There was no clean-up after they left, the only left behind a great looking house.

Our work carries a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If something isn't right, you call the office that quoted it.

sections.heading: When a Roof Is Finished
body: Some roofs fail loudly, with a leak over the bed. Most fail quietly: shingles that curl at the edges, cracks, bare patches where the granules wore off, and tabs the wind keeps lifting.
Check the gutters after a storm. Gritty granules in the downspout mean the shingles are shedding the layer that protects them from sun and rain.
If you've had a leak in two places or more, patching rarely holds. The roof is wearing out everywhere, and you're paying to chase it.

image.alt: New roof on a ranch house seen from the yard
image.brief: ranch house with a freshly finished roof, house on the right, clean front yard leading off to the left, calm sky behind the text side, no readable text, no people

sections.heading: What Hail Does
body: Hail doesn't have to punch a hole to ruin a roof. It bruises the shingle and cracks the mat under the granules, and the damage stays quiet until the first hard rain.
That's why a roof can look fine from the driveway and still need replacing. It takes someone on the roof to see it.
Metal roofs take hail differently. They dent, and a bad storm can damage them enough to replace.

sections.quote: TWG Construction worked with my Insurance company and replaced my metal hail damaged roof. They also replaced a hail damaged door, awning and siding. They did a fantastic job!
sections.name: Mark B.

sections.heading: Repair or Replace
body: A small repair makes sense when the damage is limited and the rest of the roof is sound. A replacement makes sense when the damage is widespread, the roof is worn through, or your adjuster has already called it.
We look at the roof first, then give you a price for what it needs.

sections.heading: What a Roof Replacement Looks Like
body: The old roof comes off all the way. Soft wood underneath has to be dealt with, because a new roof over a bad deck won't last.
Then the new roof goes on, with the edges and the spots around anything that goes through the roof done carefully. Those are the places that leak first.
When the crew is done, they clean up. That's what a roof job should leave behind: a good roof and a clean yard.

sections.quote: TWG came out and looked at our roof, gave us an estimate and we were impressed. Brad was very though and explained every detail. When the crew came out to remove the old roof and replace it they were very courteous and took care of every detail, our yard was cleaner when they left than it was before they came. The roof looks great and has been up long enough to go through several rain storms. No leaks, no tabs blown off and a follow up call to make sure we were happy!
sections.name: Michael S.

sections.heading: Working With Your Insurance Company
body: If hail did it, there's a claim, and the claim has a process. The adjuster comes, writes up what they find and sets a number.
We work directly with your adjuster to maximize your coverage. We explain what the report means for your roof, so you aren't left reading a letter on your own.
Hail damage is easy to miss from the ground, so it helps to have the person who looked at your roof in the conversation.

sections.quote: They were very professional in how they did the overall roof. They even adjusted my claim to help me out. The finished job looks fantastic!!
sections.name: Linda M.

sections.heading: Roofs That Last
body: A roof is one of the biggest purchases on a house, and you only want to buy it once. The best proof is a roof that's still good years later.
We use quality materials and we do the job so it holds. A roof that fails in five years is expensive for everyone.

sections.quote: The crew at TWG came out and did a top notch job on our roof. After 5 years it still looked so great, we had them do the roof of another (rental) house. Both times, they went above and beyond to the the best job possible with top quality materials, and did it quickly to boot!
sections.name: Phil B.

sections.heading: Roof, Gutters and the Rest of the House
body: A new roof meets the gutters, and the gutters meet the siding. If any of those are damaged too, it's cheaper to fix them in one visit.
We've changed gutters along with roofs, and we replace siding, windows and doors. If you've had storm damage, we'll look at all of it.

sections.quote: His team roofed my house changed gutters and offered invaluable advice. Very competitive prices, would definetly use services again!

hero.h1: Window Replacement in Wichita, KS — TWG Construction
hero.sub: If a window has fogged up, rotted at the frame or been cracked by hail, we replace it. Some Wichita homeowners still know us as the Window Guys, and windows are part of what we've done since 1986. Call for a free estimate.

sections.heading: Why Windows Fail
body: Fog between the panes means the seal around the glass has failed. Air and moisture get in, the insulating space between the panes is gone, and the fog never clears.

A window that is soft or stained at the frame has had water behind it, and a rotted frame doesn't get better. A sash that sticks, a draft you can feel with the window shut or a room that never gets comfortable all point the same way. The window has stopped doing its job.
Hail adds one more cause. It cracks glass outright, and it can break the seal on a window that looks fine.

image.alt: Replacement window seen from outside in a clean wall
image.brief: a single new white replacement window seen from outside, window on the right, calm wall on the left, no readable text, no people

sections.heading: Seals, Rot and Warranty Work
body: A failed seal is the most common reason people call us about a window that still opens and closes. You can't fix it by cleaning the glass.

sections.quote: They recently replaced two windows with faulty seals and did not charge me for the replacement, no questions asked. So I know they stand behind their products.
sections.name: Jeff N.

body: Our work carries a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If a window isn't right, we want to hear about it, and we'll deal with it.

sections.heading: Repair or Replace
body: Not every window problem needs a new window. A stuck sash or a loose lock may be a hardware fix, and a rotted frame usually isn't.
We look at the window, the frame and the wall around it, then tell you what makes sense. When the frame is rotted, replacing it is how the problem gets fixed.
If there is a cheaper way to do the job right, we'll say so.

sections.quote: The Window Guys helped me fix some rotted windows. They were professional, on time and showed me ways to save money in the project. Well done!
sections.name: Doug B.

sections.heading: A Few Windows or the Whole House
body: Some people replace the one window that failed. Others do the whole house at once so every window matches.
Either works. Replacing them all at once gets every window on the house the same age, with the same look.

sections.quote: Scott and his guys replaced a few windows in our home. His team was on time and very professional through the whole process. We highly recommend
sections.name: Colin F.

sections.heading: Choosing a Replacement Window
body: Replacement windows come in a few basic styles.
A double-hung window slides up and down and is common in older houses. A casement swings out on a crank. A slider moves side to side, and a picture window doesn't open at all.
The right one depends on the room. A bedroom may need a window that opens wide enough to climb out of in an emergency. A big living-room window might be fixed glass.
Which windows bother you most, and why? Bring photos if you can. We'll look at the opening and the room, and talk through what fits.

sections.heading: Windows With Siding and Paint
body: Windows sit in the wall, so the work around them matters as much as the glass. The siding meets the trim, and the trim meets the window.
That's why we do all of it. When you replace windows with siding, the trim, the siding and the finish come from the same company and match.

sections.quote: We now have new windows, siding and a fantastic new color on our house. All the guys were nice and respectful. We will definitely call TWG when we need another project done! I love my house!
sections.name: Jessica H.

sections.heading: Windows After a Hailstorm
body: When hail damages windows, it often damages the siding and the roof too. That usually means an insurance claim, with an adjuster who needs to see all of it.
We work directly with your adjuster. We look at the windows, the roof, the siding and the doors, so the claim covers everything the storm did.

items.q: Will insurance pay for new windows?
items.a: It depends on your policy and on what caused the damage. Hail damage is commonly part of a storm claim, and we'll work with your adjuster. Worn-out windows usually are not covered.

items.q: Can you replace just one window?
items.a: Yes. You can replace one window, a few, or all of them.
Yes. We install entry and security doors in vinyl, wood and fiberglass, along with windows.

items.q: What if there's a problem after the install?
items.a: Call (316) 685-1010. Our work carries a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee.

sections.heading: What to Have Ready
body: You don't need much. A few details help us start in the right place:
list: What you noticed: a leak, fogged windows, damaged siding, or hail
Photos of the damage, if you have them
Your insurance claim number or the adjuster's report, if you've already filed
tail: If you haven't filed a claim yet, call us anyway. We can look at the house and explain where you stand.
If you're not sure whether the damage is from hail or from age, that's a fine reason to call. We'll look at the roof, siding or windows and tell you what we see.

sections.quote: They were very quick with providing a bid for our job and were extremely transparent about the costs and how they may change.

sections.heading: Where We Work
sections.text: We serve Wichita, Kansas, from our one office in Wichita. We're licensed and insured general contractors, and every estimate is free. Call us at (316) 685-1010. Tell us what you're seeing and we'll set up a time that works for you. If you reach voicemail, leave your name, your address and a short note about the problem, and we'll call you back. We'd rather hear about a small problem early than a big one after the next storm.

footer.about: TWG Construction is a licensed and insured general contractor in Wichita, KS, known to some customers as The Window Guys. We replace roofs, repair hail damage and install siding, windows and doors.
why: Hail damage handled with your insurance company

When hail hits Wichita, homeowners want one company for the roof, the insurance and the clean-up. Your Google reviews say that is you; roofs, hail and insurance come up most. One wrote, "They worked with the insurance company to get the money needed for repairs."

Your website never says roofing. Its top line says "Remodeling & Renovation Contractors", so someone searching for a roofing company in Wichita may never see you. Its phone number also differs from Google's, and two numbers can cost you both calls.
So we built a demo that leads with roofing, gives roof replacement and window replacement their own pages, and shows one number everywhere.

One number, the one on your Google profile, on every page, one tap to call.
